what: Step 0 only instructs parsing SESSION_TMPDIR and reviewer flags, not SESSION_ID, while the proposed Step 5b passes SESSION_ID into the publisher
scenario_or_breakage: SESSION_ID may never be bound in the orchestrator context so --run-id can be empty or wrong unless the model invents a variable
suggested_fix: Extend Step 0 parsing instructions to bind SESSION_ID from session-setup output, or drop that variable and have design-log-publish.sh read the canonical run id from $DESIGN_TMPDIR/session-id (written by session-setup per scripts/session-setup.sh:279-283)
